authors.name: Editorial Team
authors.bio: Our editorial team brings years of experience in marine aquarium care, compatibility, and stocking.

editorial.testing: We combine aquarium husbandry literature with experienced marine aquarist reports to source our compatibility logic. Every claim is cited to its primary data source.
editorial.revenue: We make money through affiliate commissions when you purchase aquarium supplies using our links. These are always marked clearly with 'sponsored'.
editorial.corrections: If we get stocking logic wrong, we fix it and update our algorithms. Contact us to report any issues or submit citations.
